verdict.rationale: The documented quickstart starts self-serve in the Playground (log in, paste state, add a Noul question), then walks through the first API call with the SDKs. Install commands exist for Python (`uv add typesafe-sdk`) and JavaScript (`npm install @typesafe-ai/sdk`), and the models docs give cURL/Python/JavaScript examples. One community user independently describes an 'extremely low barrier to entry to prototype' a classifier. missing for 10: the actual runnable first-call code snippet in the evidence, documented API-key/auth setup steps, any 'minutes' time-to-first-call claim or hands-on timing, and coverage beyond Python/JavaScript/cURL.
